narrative.intro: SLS Federal Services has $2.4B in contract obligations for FY2026 to date. SLS Federal Services has won 3 awards in the current fiscal year, producing an average award size of $793M. SLS Federal Services recorded no obligations in FY21, FY22, FY23, FY24, or FY25, and all reported obligations in the dataset are for FY26. The current-year total is partial, reflecting fiscal year to date activity rather than a full-year sum. The concentration of obligations into FY26 and the large average award size indicate that a small number of high-value awards drive the vendor's federal revenue so far this fiscal year. Procurement teams and competitors should note that obligations prior to FY26 are shown as zero in this dataset, and that the note clarifies obligations are the measure used except where award-value figures are explicitly called out as total contract values.
